title: Phase 8: SOS CoAP resource (/sos)
description: Add /sos to the Python node. PUT triggers an SOS beacon (repeats every 30 s, pre-empting normal traffic). DELETE cancels. Observable — all reachable nodes receive a notification and can relay/escalate. Exit criterion: SOS priority handling works end-to-end in the simulator.
close_reason: SOS CoAP resource (/sos) is fully implemented in emergency.py with SosResource class. POST activates with origin signature verification, DELETE cancels with auth, GET/Observe expose state to all subscribers. The retrigger() method supports 30s periodic beacons. Supporting modules sos_origin.py and sos_relay.py handle cross-relay authentication and TTL-limited deduplication. Comprehensive tests exist in test_sos_resource.py, test_sos_origin.py, and test_sos_relay.py.
